description:
Here are the descriptions of the provided plots, following your guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and WER (Word Error Rate) for different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and has a linear scale ranging from 25 to 42.5, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. 

A brown line with circular markers represents "small AdaLoRA_int4", starting at a WER of approximately 33.2 at epoch 0, decreasing to approximately 26.1 at epoch 5, and ending at approximately 25.3 at epoch 6. A light brown dashed line represents "small int4", beginning at a WER of approximately 30.5 at epoch 0, decreasing to approximately 27.5 at epoch 3, then decreasing to approximately 25.0 at epoch 6. A dark brown dashed line represents "small int8", starting at a WER of approximately 36.2 at epoch 0, decreasing to approximately 32.5 at epoch 2, then decreasing to approximately 28.5 at epoch 6. A yellow line with circular markers represents "small AdaLoRA_int8", starting at a WER of approximately 41.5 at epoch 0, decreasing to approximately 37.5 at epoch 2, then decreasing to approximately 33.5 at epoch 6.
